idea-plugin.name: estorm
idea-plugin.description:
Support for estorm boards (.estorm), a plain-text notation for Event Storming.

  • Each part of a line coloured like the sticky it becomes, with colours of your own in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | estorm
  • Parse errors and modelling warnings as you type
  • Every mention of the event under the caret highlighted
  • Completion of keywords, and of events, aggregates, externals and actors already on the board
  • Go to definition from an event to the steps that produce it, and rename of events, aggregates, externals and actors everywhere on the board
  • A live preview of the board beside the text: click a sticky to select its line; drag to pan; zoom with the toolbar, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or a pinch; click a section's name to fit it
  • Line comments with #, and matching brackets

Errors, highlights, completion, go to definition and rename come from estorm's language server, which the plugin bundles and runs on Node.js 20 or later. Colours and the preview work without Node.js.
